No,
Carex Health Brands
does not sell or distribute high-tech wearable medical devices
(such as smart rings, continuous glucose monitors, or wearable ECG monitors).
Core Product Lines
Instead of wearables,
Carex
focuses on traditional in-home medical equipment, self-care items, and daily living aids:
Mobility Aids:
Walkers, rollators, canes, and wheelchairs.
Bathroom Safety:
Shower chairs, transfer benches, and raised toilet seats.
Pain Relief & Therapy:
TENS units, hot/cold packs (Bed Buddy/Thera-Med lines), and bright light therapy lamps.
Home Care & Daily Living:
Bed rails, overbed tables, cushions, and pill organizers.
